title: Segment
description: One row per classified passage of an accepted SourceDocument. This is the record that carries the LET label -- there is no separate 'labeller' table; classification is a field on this contract, produced by whichever code path (keyword cascade, LLM call, human reviewer) last wrote it.

segment_id.description: Stable across reprocessing. Never regenerated on re-run -- the BUAS audit flagged random UUID regeneration on reprocessing as a provenance defect (WP2 B3 finding).

model_id.description: Which model/heuristic produced this label, e.g. 'keyword_cascade_v1' or 'azure-gpt-4o'. Mandatory -- v5.0 section 16 requires labeller versioning; the BUAS repo's F10 finding was that no prompt/model version was ever stored.

rationale.description: One-line justification from the classifier, kept for reviewer efficiency. Not authoritative.
